steps.body: A story with three collections becomes a three-addend equation. Every collection mentioned belongs in the total.
steps.narration: A story with three collections becomes a three-addend equation. Every collection mentioned belongs in the total.

widget.prompt: Maggie collects 3, then 7, then 4. Group 3 + 7 to make ten, then join 4.
widget.missFeedback: Start at 10 and count on 4: you land on 14.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 14 — the ten-partner pair made the story easy to finish.

predict.prompt: A story mentions three collections. How many addends does the equation need?
predict.reveal: Every collection joins the total, so all three appear as addends.
